composition_label: Structured extraction -> Web research -> Product comparison

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version, synthetic=true, fields, documents, allowed_hosts, pages, preferences.
shared_schema.fields: Named string or numeric fields, literal line labels, required flags. Numeric fields declare canonical unit and positive conversion factors, canonical factor 1.
shared_schema.documents: Unique product_id, source text, ordered unique HTTPS research_urls.
shared_schema.pages: Synthetic offline fixtures with unique URL, title and text; no network retrieval.
shared_schema.preferences: Unique field preferences with positive finite weight; min/max for numeric fields, target for strings.
shared_schema.evidence: Typed value, source unit, raw text, zero-based half-open character span and document/page source provenance.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, extraction, research, comparison; each stage has schema_version and product-ID-preserving products.
shared_schema.validation: Single validate function handles input and all stage boundaries; validates source slices, handoff identities, retrieved findings, normalization and ranking.

cross_stage_handoffs: Extraction validates input and emits product field evidence, research URLs and missing-field reports. Research validates this output before ingesting URLs.
Research carries document evidence and appends ordered page findings and retrieval status per URL. Comparison validates this combined output before selecting and normalizing evidence.

behavior.extraction: First case-insensitive literal Label: value line per field. Empty labels count as missing. Invalid present numeric values fail validation. Required omissions are reported, not fatal.
behavior.research: Exact lowercase hostname allowlist; HTTPS only; credentials, nonstandard ports, whitespace and fragments rejected. Only referenced fixtures are ingested. Blocked or absent fixtures yield blocked/unavailable status, never network fallback.
behavior.selection: Document value wins; otherwise first retrieved page value. Alternatives and normalized conflicts are retained.
behavior.comparison: Products form side-by-side rows with identical attribute columns. Numeric conversion uses field factors; strings normalize whitespace and case. Missing required attributes remain reported.
behavior.ranking: Weighted min/max relative utility or exact normalized string target. Missing values score 0; equal present numeric values score 1. Scores rounded to 12 decimals. Ties sort by product_id.
behavior.cli: One JSON object to stdout, exit 0 on success; JSON status error and exit 2 for validation, JSON, usage and file errors.
